versions.content: The Main Time Tuple shall only be updated  after setting a new Global Time or a new Rate Correction value by the application  after obtaining a Received Time Tuple (i.e., a new Time Tuple) from a Timesync Module  after t he Offset Correction By Rate Adaption interval (see [SWS_StbM_00353] ) However, the Main Time Tuple may be updated if there has been no update for more than 3s.
